description: Archived individual runs of the NCEP GFS deterministic model, four per day, as served by the Open-Meteo single runs API
licence: Open-Meteo free tier is for non-commercial use; data CC BY 4.0. Underlying data: NOAA NCEP, public domain.

coverage.archive_start_note: Earliest run the archive returned when probed on 2026-10-04; runs of 2025 and earlier answer 'The requested model run is not available'.

hours_kept: the evaluation window of each valid date, "The frozen Seam 1 signature takes a date and no time, so the window interval I(d) of spec II.20 is these hours. Hourly values labelled 07:00 to 12:00 local, both included, are evaluated."
